newsitem.title: FRANCE: COB warns French investors on two companies.
newsitem.headline: COB warns French investors on two companies.

text.p: France's stock market regulator warned French investors on Friday from doing business with two companies it is investigating.

The Commission des Operations de Bourse (COB) said it was in the process of investigating the activities of WWB International Ltd, a Bermuda-registered company and German Financial Ltd, also known under the names GF Finanzmanagement Gmbh and Royal Trade Company, based in Germany.
The COB said these companies were offering, to French residents, operations on foreign futures markets that could break the rules governing financial solicitation.
"The COB warns individuals against these offers and invites people who have signed contracts with these companies to make themselves known," the COB said in a statement.
